evidence: interface.md describes validateLedger as requiring both unique IDs and 'identical-content duplicate semantics.' These conflict: clarify that a persisted ledger must contain unique IDs, while mergeRecords skips identical incoming duplicates and rejects differing ones.

interface.md does not define normalized-content equality. Require comparison of the six canonical field values rather than object identity or JSON serialization, so harmless property-order differences in an existing valid ledger do not produce false conflicts.

The Primary integration section explicitly requires full ledger validation for import but not report. Require report to parse and call validateLedger before monthlyReport; otherwise malformed but parseable ledger data can produce invalid output instead of a clear error.

CSV line-ending consistency is ambiguous around quoted content. State that CR/LF syntax checks apply only to record delimiters outside quotes and that CR, LF, or CRLF inside quoted fields is preserved verbatim, as required for note text.
Report ordering lacks a deterministic category comparator. Specify ascending Unicode code-unit comparison for currency and category, avoiding environment-dependent localeCompare ordering.
residual_risks: This was limited to the committed documents requested; no implementation or runtime behavior was inspected or executed.

Inspected complete GOAL.md, cli.cjs, all source modules, README.md, acceptance.cjs, interface.md, focused checks, accepted authority and intent records, specifications, and retained observation logs. R1: src/ledger/index.cjs monthlyReport checks each Number partial sum. Same-month, same-group amounts of 9007199254740991, 1, and -1 cents are individually valid and have a safe final total, but reporting throws on the second record. Reordering to 9007199254740991, -1, 1 succeeds by inspection. Accumulate with BigInt and range-check the final total. R2: interface.md requires rejecting inconsistent record-delimiter CR/LF outside quotes, but src/csv/index.cjs accepts LF and CRLF independently without tracking consistency. A CRLF header followed by LF records is accepted. Align the documented interface with intended GOAL behavior.

Retained observations, not reviewer-executed tests: baseline.json records 1/8 checks passing, including the explicitly seeded 112-versus-113 conversion failure; first-integration.txt records 3/8 and exit 1; acceptance-final.txt records 8/8 and exit 0; focused-final.txt records 3/3 and exit 0. Current money conversion uses BigInt. No commands were run.
residual_risks: Read-only inspection only: findings were not executed, retained test results were not independently reproduced, and supplied identity/hash bindings were preserved without command-based verification.
